mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, it is a beautiful 54 degrees with clear skies along the Military Ridge State Trail.

Mayor Diaz has officially designated October as Community Planning Month. This is a time to recognize the City of Verona's Planning and Development Department for their hard work in shaping our future and handling complex land use and housing questions for our community.

There is plenty to do this weekend! Today, head over to the Wisconsin State Capitol for the Dane County Farmers Market. Tomorrow, check out the World Dairy Expo at the Alliant Energy Center or visit the Farley Center Fall Festival for their annual cider pressing.
Looking at the most recent activity, on Sunday, September 21, an individual was identified and cited for retail theft after taking candy from a store in the 400 block of East Verona Avenue.
Today's flavor of the day at Culver's is the delicious Really Reese's. The store is closed right now but will open today at 10:00 AM for you to enjoy your treat.
